strings: m_c tells r_c0 flatly that since sleeping hasn't been helping {PRONOUN/m_c/object} feel any less tired, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/don't/doesn't} see the point of it.
Due to the fact that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} always tired anyway, m_c decides that sleeping isn't necessary.
Thanks to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} fatigue, m_c hasn't been sleeping well recently.
